fullPassage:
During New York Fashion Week 2018, a woman with a brightly decorated prosthetic leg proudly walked the runway at a major fashion show. She was Mama Cax, a model and influencer.

Cax was diagnosed with cancer at age 14 and lost her right leg at 16 after surgery. At first, Cax was depressed and struggled to accept her new body. However, with the support of her family and friends, Cax learned to love it. One day when she was 26, Cax posted a picture on social media showing her leg. "I didn't think it could help anyone," she said in an interview, "But after receiving messages of support, I realized my story could inspire others." After receiving support from others, she began to use social media to share more about her life and to inspire others. She proudly posted pictures of herself wearing stylish prosthetic covers and spoke out about body positivity and fashion. In 2016, she became the first model for the #RunwayForAll campaign. In 2018, she appeared on the cover of major fashion magazines.

When asked, "How did you come to embrace yourself?" she replied, "The truth is, like many people, I'm still on my journey to self-love. There are many barriers ahead." In addition to modeling, Cax showed her ability to overcome physical barriers by swimming, playing basketball, and mountain climbing. She even finished the New York City Marathon in a wheelchair.

Sadly, Mama Cax's journey was cut short in 2019. Although she is no longer with us, her journey will remain in our hearts, inspiring us to overcome limitations and find our own paths to success and happiness.

questions.passage: During New York Fashion Week 2018, a woman with a brightly decorated prosthetic leg proudly walked the runway at a major fashion show. She was Mama Cax, a model and influencer. Cax was diagnosed with cancer at age 14 and lost her right leg at 16 after surgery. At first, Cax was (A)[depressed / delighted] and struggled to accept her new body. However, with the (B)[support / criticism] of her family and friends, Cax learned to (C)[love / loathe] it. One day when she was 26, Cax posted a picture on social media showing her leg.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: Cax는 처음에 우울했고(depressed) 새 몸을 받아들이기 힘들어했다. 하지만 가족과 친구들의 지지(support)로 자신의 몸을 사랑하는(love) 법을 배웠다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① depressed — support — love: 원문 일치. 다리를 잃고 우울 → 가족의 지지 → 사랑으로의 변화 과정
❌ ② delighted(기뻐하는): 다리를 잃은 직후이므로 기쁨은 맥락과 모순
❌ ③ criticism(비판): 가족이 비판했다면 사랑을 배우는 결과와 모순
❌ ④ loathe(혐오하다): 제목이 'Self-Love'이므로 혐오는 부적절
det.tip: depressed(우울한) ↔ delighted(기뻐하는), support(지지) ↔ criticism(비판), love(사랑) ↔ loathe(혐오하다)

questions.passage: At first, Cax was depressed and struggled to accept her new body. However, with the support of her family and friends, Cax learned to love it. One day when she was 26, Cax posted a picture on social media showing her leg. She proudly posted pictures of herself wearing stylish prosthetic covers and spoke out about body positivity and fashion. In 2016, she became the first model for the #RunwayForAll campaign.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 지지 메시지를 받은 후, 자신의 이야기가 다른 사람들에게 영감을 줄(inspire) 수 있다고 깨달았다(realized). 그녀는 세련된(stylish) 의족 커버를 착용한 사진을 자랑스럽게 올렸다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② realized — inspire — stylish: 원문 일치. 지지 메시지로 깨달음 → 영감 → 세련된 커버의 흐름
❌ ① discourage(낙담시키다): 'body positivity'라는 긍정적 맥락과 모순
❌ ③ doubted(의심했다): 지지 메시지를 받고 '의심'은 어색. 깨달음이 자연스러움
❌ ④ plain(수수한): 'proudly'와 'fashion' 맥락에서 수수한은 부적절
det.tip: realized(깨달았다) ↔ doubted(의심했다), inspire(영감을 주다) ↔ discourage(낙담시키다), stylish(세련된) ↔ plain(수수한)

questions.passage: In 2016, she became the first model for the #RunwayForAll campaign. In 2018, she appeared on the cover of major fashion magazines. When asked, "How did you come to embrace yourself?" she replied, "The truth is, like many people, I'm still on my journey to self-love. There are many (A)[barriers / shortcuts] ahead." In addition to modeling, Cax showed her ability to (B)[overcome / avoid] physical barriers by swimming, playing basketball, and mountain climbing. She even (C)[finished / abandoned] the New York City Marathon in a wheelchair. Sadly, Mama Cax's journey was cut short in 2019.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 앞에 많은 장벽(barriers)이 있다. 모델 활동 외에도 수영, 농구, 산악 등반으로 신체적 장벽을 극복하는(overcome) 능력을 보여주었다. 그녀는 뉴욕시 마라톤을 완주했다(finished).
det.analysis:
✅ ③ barriers — overcome — finished: 원문 일치. 장벽 인식 → 극복 → 마라톤 완주의 의지 과정
❌ ① avoid(피하다): 수영, 농구 등으로 적극 도전했으므로 '피하다'는 모순
❌ ② shortcuts(지름길): '자기 사랑의 여정'에 지름길은 맥락과 어울리지 않음
❌ ④ abandoned(포기했다): 마라톤을 '포기'했다면 극복의 메시지와 모순
det.tip: barriers(장벽) ↔ shortcuts(지름길), overcome(극복하다) ↔ avoid(피하다), finished(완주하다) ↔ abandoned(포기하다)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 그녀의 여정은 우리에게 한계(limitations)를 극복하고 성공과 행복을 향한 길을 찾도록 영감을 준다. advantages(이점)는 원문의 limitations(한계)와 반대이다.

✅ ④ advantages → limitations(한계): 원문은 'overcome limitations'. 극복의 대상은 한계이지 이점(advantages)이 아님
❌ ① cut short(단축된): 원문 그대로. 2019년에 여정이 짧게 끝남(사망)
❌ ② remain(남다): 원문 그대로. 우리 마음속에 남을 것
❌ ③ inspiring(영감을 주는): 원문 그대로. 현재분사 분사구문

det.tip: spoke out = advocated: 공개적으로 의견을 내다/옹호하다. speak out about = ~에 대해 목소리를 높이다

questions.passage:
During New York Fashion Week 2018, a woman with a brightly decorated prosthetic leg proudly walked the runway at a major fashion show. She was Mama Cax, a model and influencer.

Cax was diagnosed with cancer at age 14 and lost her right leg at 16 after surgery. At first, Cax was depressed and struggled to accept her new body. However, with the support of her family and friends, Cax learned to love it. One day when she was 26, Cax posted a picture on social media showing her leg. "I didn't think it could help anyone," she said in an interview, "But after receiving messages of support, I realized my story could inspire others." After receiving support from others, she began to use social media to share more about her life and to inspire others. She proudly posted pictures of herself wearing stylish prosthetic covers and spoke out about body positivity and fashion. In 2016, she became the first model for the #RunwayForAll campaign. In 2018, she appeared on the cover of major fashion magazines.

When asked, "How did you come to embrace yourself?" she replied, "The truth is, like many people, I'm still on my journey to self-love. There are many barriers ahead." In addition to modeling, Cax showed her ability to overcome physical barriers by swimming, playing basketball, and mountain climbing. She even finished the New York City Marathon in a wheelchair.

Sadly, Mama Cax's journey was <u>cut short</u> in 2019. Although she is no longer with us, her journey will remain in our hearts, inspiring us to overcome limitations and find our own paths to success and happiness.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>cut short</u>과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: Mama Cax의 여정은 2019년에 짧게 끝났다(cut short).
det.analysis:
✅ ④ terminated(끝났다/종료되다): cut short와 유의어. '일찍 끝나다/중단되다'의 의미
❌ ① extended(연장되다): cut short(짧게 끝나다)의 정반대
❌ ③ celebrated(축하되다): 'Sadly'로 시작하므로 축하의 맥락이 아님
❌ ② documented(기록되다): 끝난 것과 기록된 것은 다른 의미
det.tip: cut short = terminate prematurely: 예정보다 일찍 끝나다. 'Sadly'가 부정적 결말의 단서

questions.stem:
다음 영영 풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"to accept or support something willingly and enthusiastically"

det.korean: "기꺼이 열정적으로 받아들이거나 지지하다"에 해당하는 단어는 embrace(포용하다)이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ embrace(포용하다/받아들이다): 기꺼이(willingly) + 열정적으로(enthusiastically) + 받아들이다(accept) = embrace
❌ ① abandon(버리다): 받아들이다와 정반대
❌ ② criticize(비판하다): 지지하다와 반대
❌ ③ tolerate(참다/견디다): '참는 것'은 열정적으로 받아들이는 것과 다름. 소극적 수용
det.tip: embrace = willingly accept/support. tolerate는 마지못해 참는 것, embrace는 적극적으로 받아들이는 것

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 괄호 안의 단어를 문맥에 맞게 변형하시오.

Cax was diagnosed with cancer at age 14 and lost her right leg after surgery. At first, Cax was depressed and struggled with the [accept] of her new reality. Her [inspire] story encouraged many people around the world.

※ 쉼표(,)로 구분하여 순서대로 (   ) 쓰시오. (2단어) (영어로)

det.korean: accept → acceptance(명사: 수용/인정), inspire → inspiring(형용사: 영감을 주는).
det.analysis: accept(동사: 받아들이다) → acceptance(명사: 수용). 'struggled with the _____ of'에서 전치사 the와 of 사이에 명사가 필요하므로 acceptance. inspire(동사: 영감을 주다) → inspiring(현재분사→형용사: 영감을 주는). Her inspiring story = 그녀의 영감을 주는 이야기
det.tip: accept(v) → acceptance(n) → acceptable(adj). inspire(v) → inspiring(adj, 능동) / inspired(adj, 수동). -ing는 '~을 주는', -ed는 '~을 받는'

Although she is no longer with us, her journey will remain in our hearts, inspiring us to overcome [limit] and find our own paths to success and [happy].

※ 쉼표(,)로 구분하여 순서대로 (   ) 쓰시오. (2단어) (영어로)

det.korean: limit → limitations(명사 복수: 한계들), happy → happiness(명사: 행복).
det.analysis: limit(동사/명사) → limitations(명사 복수: 한계들). 원문은 'overcome limitations'으로 복수형 필수. happy(형용사) → happiness(명사). 'success and happiness'에서 and 병렬 구조상 명사끼리 연결
det.tip: limit(v/n) → limitation(n, 한계) → limitations(복수). happy(adj) → happiness(n). -ness는 형용사→명사 접미사 (sad→sadness, kind→kindness)
